lines.text: What happens if a single grain of sand strikes Earth at ninety-nine point nine percent the speed of light?
A grain of sand weighs just one milligram, but at relativistic speeds, its kinetic energy becomes apocalyptic.
The moment it hits Earth's atmosphere, air molecules cannot move away, fusing together in instant thermonuclear fusion!
It releases the explosive force of multiple tons of TNT, carving a massive glowing crater into the ground.
